title: Chapter 10: Tripura — Education, Science & Key Institutions

blocks.content: Tripura's literacy rate of 87.75% (Census 2011) is the third highest in India, after Kerala (93.91%) and Lakshadweep (91.85%). This remarkable achievement — for a state that was poorly developed at the time of merger (1949) — is largely attributable to the Left Front governments (1978–2018) which emphasised mass education, particularly in rural and tribal areas. The state has over 4,600 schools and near-universal primary school enrollment.

items: Male literacy: 92.18% — among highest in India
Female literacy: 83.15% — significantly above national average (65.5%)
Tribal literacy: Has improved dramatically; tribal areas have benefited from residential schools
No child labour (declared): Tripura has achieved near-zero child labour through education push
